entities.summary: Nurzhan Smanov is a retired boxer from Kazakhstan, who competed for his native country in the Men's Welterweight division at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia. He was defeated in the quarterfinals by Cuba's eventual silver medalist Juan Hernández Sierra.
